<b>Bone Bottom Supplies</b> is a [[Delivery Wishes|Delivery Wish]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>, acquired from [[Couriers Tipp & Pill]]. It is unavailable in [[Act 3]].
__NOTOC__

== Delivery Item ==
[[File:Courier's_Swag.png|link=Courier's Swag|left|thumb|100x100px]]
The [[Courier's Swag]] has a total of 5 hit points. It takes 1 damage for every Mask of damage Hornet takes, and also when Hornet makes a heavy landing, hits a ceiling while using [[Silk Soar]], or runs into a wall while using [[Swift Step]]. Travelling with the [[Bellways]], [[Ventrica]], [[Flea Caravan]] or using the [[Beastling Call]] immediately destroys it.
{{Clear}}

== Wish ==
[[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] is given a Courier's Swag by Tipp & Pill to carefully deliver to [[Flick the Fixer]] in [[Bone Bottom]].

This Delivery can be repeated an infinite amount of times, allowing for a steady source of [[Rosaries]]. However, Tipp & Pill will only offer 2 Deliveries at a time. The most recently completed Delivery will never appear twice in a row. In addition, only the first completion of a Delivery contributes towards <i>[[Silk and Soul]]</i>.

== Possible routes ==
===The Marrow route===
This route goes through the hidden path in the [[Bellhart]] Bellway leading to [[the Marrow]] to reach Bone Bottom.
{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Bone Bottom Supplies 01.png!The Marrow route
}}
=== Shellwood route ===
This route goes through [[Shellwood]] to drop down into Bone Bottom.
{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Bone Bottom Supplies 02.png!Shellwood route
}}

== Reward ==
[[File:Rosaries large.png|link=Rosaries|left|thumb|100x100px]]

By turning in the supplies to Flick the Fixer, he rewards Hornet with {{R|150}}.

{{Clear}}
